codeReview.summary: The reviewed commit only updates `app/(tabs)/workers.tsx` and `src/components/cards/worker-card.tsx`; the attendance redesign described in the feature contract was not implemented. The current attendance UI is still a single-worker date-range grid with a conditional save bar, which does not match the required attendance rows, arrow-based date navigator, or persistent sticky action button from the validation contract and worker-attendance wireframes.

issues.description: The attendance tab still renders `dateRange.map(...)` for one `selectedWorker` instead of a list of worker rows. The required redesign/wireframe is a per-worker attendance list with avatar, worker name, daily rate, and a Full/Half/Absent pill toggle on each row, so VAL-ATTEND-001 is not implemented.

This screen uses separate `From` / `To` date pickers rather than a single bordered date navigator with left/right arrows and a centered 15px/600 date label. That misses VAL-ATTEND-002 and the `date-sel` pattern shown in `wireframe-worker-attendance.html`.

The bottom CTA only appears when `hasModifications` is true and saves edits with `t('common.save')`. The contract requires an always-visible sticky primary button for `Mark All Present`, so VAL-ATTEND-003 is still unmet.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The assigned `ui-worker` procedure requires reading both light and dark wireframes before implementation, but this worker skipped that step and treated the existing attendance UI as sufficient.

summary: Reviewed feature `workers-and-attendance-redesign` using the handoff, transcript skeleton, commit `b7611a005c76d5539a342157aad3db7e62f54a36`, current implementation, and the worker attendance wireframes. The worker-card styling updates are present, but the attendance redesign still fails the contract because the app shows a single-worker date grid with a conditional save bar instead of worker attendance rows, an arrow-based date navigator, and an always-visible `Mark All Present` sticky CTA.
